text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to unpin runtime 2.14 -> 2.15 on canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need warmup and KV cache checks for long-sequence workloads. Will exclude known incompatible models and follow the rollback runbook.
andre: What's the rollback trigger if errors jump?
sophie: Per runbook it's auto-revert on 5% error rate increase sustained for 5m. Also want a pre-warm step (see snippet).
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary unpin at 2026-03-23T03:00Z by @maria. Canary regions: eu-west-1, us-east-1. Changed pinlist: removed runtime:2.14 for canary targets. Job id: cb-3141592653.
raj: Quick question — SDK 1.8 had a header rename in PR#512; is that compatible with runtime 2.15 KV index layout?
maria: Good catch. SDK team confirmed RPCs are backward-compatible but KV index format changed. We'll set compat_mode: legacy-kv for the canary so SDK1.8 clients keep working.
sophie: Add header to canary traffic: `X-RW-Compat: legacy-kv`. Also watch p95 latency tail carefully.
devops-oncall: I'll tail canary metrics and keep pager ready. If p95 latency > 200ms for 5m we'll re-pin and abort rollout.
maria: Adding a quick smoke prompt set in s3://redwood/evals/canary_smoke_v2.txt — please run it before shifting traffic.
andre: How much warmup tokens? Last time 50k/instance worked.
sophie: Plan is 60k tokens per instance spread over 10m to avoid cold spikes.
raj: Are any models still pinned to 2.14? Llama3q-8k was problematic earlier; we must exclude it.
maria: Yes — we'll exclude `llama3q-8k` and `gptx2-quant` from canary. I updated the exemption list in deploybot.
deploy-bot: Exemption list updated: models -> llama3q-8k, gptx2-quant. Canary window: 03:00-04:00 UTC.
jana: Doc sync request — add notes to release_notes/2.15_unpin.md and update the SDK compatibility matrix before deploy.
maria: Putting final thumbs: @andre @sophie @raj — if no objections by EOD I'll schedule.
andre: :thumbsup: fine.
raj: One more ask — can we create a temporary alert channel #canary-2-15-watch to centralize telemetry?
devops-oncall: Created #canary-2-15-watch and added ops, SRE, and SDK leads.
sophie: I'll drop the checklist in that channel before flip. Warmup curl snippet for smoke: ```bash
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do curl -s -H 'X-RW-Compat: legacy-kv' https://canary.redwood.ai/gen; done
```
maria: Thanks all — scheduling now. If anyone needs to opt out ping me directly. We'll wait 90m after canary success before broad unpin.
deploy-bot: Canary unpin job queued. Job id: cb-3141592653. Status: queued.
